title: Close the screen-tall empty gap under More in Events on /events

source.ref: Visual sweep 2026-11-02: /events at 1280 and 390 signed out; the same row renders on /network, /people, Circles, Marketplace, Crew and Settings

detail:
HubLinks renders its 'More in ...' chip row as a nav carrying data-kit="members" so the kit's .sec and .chips classes keep their meaning on a site-kit page. The members shell's root rule matches any element with that attribute, so the nav inherited the shell's own frame: min-height 100dvh, a flex column. On /events signed out that is 900px of nothing between the row and the Host panel (837px of it empty). Fix: a nested members-kit island gets min-height 0. Measured after: the nav is 63px and the page 2267px instead of about 3100.

 Fixed 2026-11-02; browser check on /events: the More in Events row is 63px, the page 2267px.
